headline: The Calculations Came In: Can You Not Make Big Profits This Year With This Crop Either?
summary: Sunflower sowing in Hungary exceeds maize for the first time in 2026, but drought-like weather has worsened considerably since spring. Producers face weak returns from the crop.
why: Sunflower seed is a key oilseed input for vegetable oil and animal feed markets. Drought-driven yield losses can tighten supply and affect farm margins.
